source: game.exe (Custom client) skill->effect dispatch, emulated per skill; reference out/skill_effects_unity.json

slots.beginCast: ZC_USESKILL_ACK with delaytime > 0 -> on the CASTER (actor msg 0x55, kept at actor+0x14c), effect duration +0x17c set by effect msg 0x50 (vf18) to delaytime/16 (int division toward zero); removed early only by ZC_DISPEL (0x1b9: actor msg 0x54 -> effect msg 0x18); nothing at all when delaytime == 0
slots.beginCastByProperty: the beginCast id per ZC_USESKILL_ACK property 0..9 (= skill element) when it depends on it
slots.beginCastOnTarget: ZC_USESKILL_ACK with a target actor != caster -> EF 60 EF_LOCKON on the TARGET (actor msg 0x56, kept at +0x150), duration +0x17c = delaytime/16; removed (actor msg 0x57 -> effect msg 0x18) when the caster leaves the casting state, on ZC_DISPEL, or when a new lock-on is placed
slots.groundScope: ZC_USESKILL_ACK on a cell -> CGroundScope area highlight (not an EF id), size in cells
slots.onCaster: ZC_NOTIFY_SKILL receipt (action start) -> on the CASTER
slots.beginCastExtra: ZC_USESKILL_ACK (delaytime > 0): additional cast-start effects launched by FUN_00c7c180/FUN_00c7f470/FUN_00c7f900 (e.g. CH_SOULCOLLECT 402, CR_ACIDDEMONSTRATION throw 539)
slots.actionMotion: ZC_NOTIFY_SKILL: caster action (CPc::SetAction index) from FUN_00d15360; 2/9 may spawn a CArrowEffect (bow / instrument-whip), see notes
slots.actionOther: ZC_NOTIFY_SKILL: non-EF side effects (motion overrides FUN_00be5f40 with act/frames/duration, screen quake)
slots.beforeHit: ZC_NOTIFY_SKILL receipt -> launched on the caster with destination = target (projectile) or on the target (see detail.beforeHit[].on/toTarget/count)
slots.hit: ZC_NOTIFY_SKILL, first hit -> on the TARGET at receipt time + attackMT (packet +0x10 in 0x114/0x1de; +500 ms extra for PR_TURNUNDEAD, +300 for skid 415/417); only when damage > 0. Unit-sourced (damageFromUnit): at receipt time, no attackMT
slots.hitEachHit: ZC_NOTIFY_SKILL, hits 2..count (count = packet count field, only for damage types 8/9/13, clamped 1..36) -> on the TARGET, each +200 ms after the previous (constant DAT_0118195c = 200; KN_PIERCE +280); unit-sourced: every hit incl. the first
slots.damageFromUnit: true when the damage packets come from the skill unit (srcAID = unit id, CSkill path): no caster/beforeHit effects, hit == hitEachHit applied to every hit (first included)
slots.use: ZC_USE_SKILL -> on the packet target (dst) actor (== caster for self skills / bl,bl packets)
slots.useOnCaster: ZC_USE_SKILL -> on the packet src actor
slots.useByAmount: ZC_USE_SKILL: id chosen by the packet level/amount field (sampled at 5/250/2500/5000; see notes for exact thresholds)
slots.useOnlyIfCasterIsLocalPlayer: ZC_USE_SKILL: extra ids launched only when the caster is the local player
slots.usePosition: ZC_USE_SKILL: launched at a position (not attached to an actor)
slots.useOther: ZC_USE_SKILL: non-EF side effects (removeEffect id on an actor, motion overrides, screen quake)
slots.liveAmounts: values of the ZC_USE_SKILL level/amount field seen in the live sweep (information only)
slots.ground: ZC_NOTIFY_GROUNDSKILL -> at the target cell (CDummyEffectLauncher, launcher lives lifetimeTicks x 24 ms (timeGetTime based), see detail.ground[].lifetimeTicks; defaultDuration = FUN_00b3c420 = out/ef_durations.tsv)
slots.groundObjects: ZC_NOTIFY_GROUNDSKILL: sprite projectile objects (CArrowEffect) instead of EF ids
slots.unitIds: ZC_SKILL_ENTRY unit ids (CSkill job) belonging to the skill; per-unit behaviour in out/skill_units_exe.json
slots.unit: ZC_SKILL_ENTRY (unit ids in unitIds) -> on the unit cell, launched/kept by CSkill (periodic or persistent)
slots.unitTrapTriggered: unit look changed to 0x8c (trap fired) -> on the unit cell
slots.hideCastBar: client sends no cast bar (msg 0x52) for this skill
slots.hideCastAura: no begin-cast effect for this skill
slots.engine: newSystem lists ids rendered by the new C++ CEffect system (FUN_00a4d090 registry) instead of CRagEffect
slots.roBrowserOnly: ids roBrowser lists for the skill that the exe never launches for it in any packet path -> stop spawning
slots.packetsSource: live = packets observed in captures/live/full (tracker sweep); inferred = from Hercules skill_db/skill.c
